start: AI Assistant open on the start view; three plans end this week

user_sees: At most four rows, most useful first
"Plans ending this week: 3" with the members named
A button "Write a renewal reminder" and "See who"
must_not: More than four rows
A row with a zero count
A count that differs from the Members page

user_sees: A list card with the three members, worked out on the device, free
must_not: A question counted or a credit used
A member whose plan ended already

steps.action: Tap "Start a new chat", then "Write a renewal reminder"
user_sees: The request in a bubble, then a message card for those three members
must_not: The message sent at once
A different group than the row counted

user_sees: "{festival} is in 3 days"; for a moon-dated day "is around 3 days away"; one day away "is tomorrow"
A button "Write a {festival} greeting"
must_not: "1 days"
A moon-dated day stated as certain
A festival that has passed

user_sees: A greeting message card for everyone
must_not: A closure message
A wrong festival name

start: Two members have a birthday today; the automatic birthday wish is on; one of them has the app

user_sees: "Birthdays today, no automatic wish: 1" naming only the member the automatic wish will not reach
must_not: Both members counted
The row shown before the switch is known, with a wrong count

user_sees: A wish for that one member
must_not: A second wish to the member who gets the automatic one

start: It is Monday; the Today page shows the AI Assistant card

steps.action: On the Today page tap an idea on the AI Assistant card
user_sees: The assistant opens with that idea asked, or its list shown
must_not: The idea is lost on the way
It is asked twice

steps.action: In the assistant read the last row
user_sees: "Your week in numbers" with "Show the summary"
must_not: The row on other days of the week

user_sees: Last week's figures
must_not: This week's part-figures
Sunday counted in the wrong week

start: A new gym with no members, no festival near, not a Monday

user_sees: No "Today for you" heading at all; "Try saying" shows
must_not: An empty "Today for you" box
Rows with zero

steps.action: With ideas showing, tap one while another question is being answered
user_sees: The rows are greyed out
must_not: A second question sent

steps.action: Tap an idea when today's questions are used up
user_sees: A plain word why nothing happens
must_not: A dead tap with no word
A credit taken

start: An idea "Not seen for {days}+ days: 4" is showing

steps.action: Tap "Write a we miss you message" and send the message
user_sees: Sent
must_not: A message to a member who joined today
A member who came yesterday

steps.action: Tap "Start a new chat" and read the ideas again
user_sees: A sign that this was done today, or the same row
must_not: The same members messaged a second time with no warning on the card

steps.action: A member on the list checks in; open the assistant again
user_sees: The count is one lower
must_not: The old count

start: Ideas show members by name and the money owed

steps.action: Read "Fees due: {n} members, {amount}" and the names under other rows
user_sees: Shown to the owner only
must_not: Shown to front desk or a trainer
Shown on the demo gym with real names

user_sees: A fixed sentence is asked
must_not: The members' names or the amount owed are sent to the AI when the owner did not type them
